parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The IPv6 address may by of one the following types. Enumeration of: * LinkLocal (Address reachable by a single radio transmission with the prefixes fe80::/16). * MeshLocal (Address reachable within the same Thread network with the prefix defined by the Thread network). * Global (Address reachable from outside a Thread network with the prefix provided by the Border Router).

parameters.name: IPAddress
parameters.description: Router ID of the route table entry.

object.description: This object represents the list of IPv6 addresses associated with the Thread node.
